answer: New agents can only join through a vine of vouching peers who risk slashing their own stake if the newcomer sybils. Each agent must sign a unique proof-of-work challenge with a quill-derived key, then forge a stake deposit locked to its on-chain identity. Attackers must burn real capital per fake identity and sustain costly compute, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
